channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: A billion-dollar company poisoned their town, then moved on. Now people are dying.
item.description: “It doesn't matter what side of the political spectrum you're coming from, nobody cared about us… we've been so let down and our trust is so broken. Everything's been taken from us.”

item.title: US commanders want to make war with Iran as ‘bloody’ as possible to bring about biblical end times, officers report
item.description: One noncommissioned officer said he was directed to tell his troops that Trump was “anointed by Jesus” and that war with Iran was “all part of God’s divine plan” to bring about Armageddon.

item.title: Sean O’Brien sold workers and unions out to Trump—these Teamsters are running to oust him.
item.description: “As a labor leader, [O’Brien] should be disqualified…. Donald Trump has done nothing to help the working class, only the people in the Epstein class.”

item.title: We covered a now-discredited medical examiner for two decades. These are the botched cases that still haunt us.
item.description: Maryland’s former chief medical examiner David Fowler helped decide the fate of many suspicious death investigations. After a scathing audit showed his office was rife with junk science and questionable rulings, we revisit the cases where Fowler’s rulings shut down the search for truth.

item.title: The chilling truth behind ICE’s detention warehouses
item.description: “The idea that the Trump administration wants to hold human beings inside of warehouses like packages at logistic facilities like this might shock a lot of people, but this is the explicit language that the administration is using.”

item.title: Why Target is the center of an ICE-out campaign in Minnesota
item.description: Labor organizer Veronica Mendez Moore explains why unions, worker centers, and other organizations are focusing on Target to lead the corporate push against ICE in Minnesota.

item.title: Trump’s war on Cuba: Crisis made in the USA | Under the Shadow S2E7
item.description: The situation in Cuba is dire. It hasn’t been this bad for decades. And it’s on purpose. This is a humanitarian crisis, made in the United States. This is episode 7 of Under the Shadow, Season 2.

item.title: ‘Good riddance’: Trump fires Kristi Noem from DHS, names ‘MAGA warrior’ as replacement
item.description: “Trump’s violent, cruel deportation agenda didn’t begin with Kristi Noem, and it won’t end with her firing,” said Rep. Summer Lee, who called for dismantling DHS and prosecuting everyone “violating our rights.”

item.title: Iran: The war Western media always wanted
item.description: Abby Martin of The Empire Files and Adam Johnson of Citations Needed break down the media’s complicity in manufacturing the conditions for the illegal US-Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: ‘Deranged and dangerous’: Trump says ‘I guess’ Americans should expect a deadly attack on US
item.description: “We have totally unserious, completely incompetent people taking us into mindless, deadly war,” said Democratic US Sen. Chris Murphy.
